article.title: Modes or methods for encryption.
article.content:
2[84A. Modes or methods for encryption.–The Central Government may, for secure use of the electronic medium and for promotion of e-governance and e-commerce, prescribe the modes or methods for encryption.
Inserted by Act 10 of 2009, s. 45 (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).
Note: the insertion bracket opened here runs through section 84C, where it closes.
